user.title: Connect your energy accounts
user.description:
Check both accounts before choosing a meter and rate.

- **ENGIE Belgium** — {engie_status}. [Open ENGIE setup](https://my.home-assistant.io/redirect/config_flow_start/?domain=engie_be) in another tab if needed. Have your dedicated ENGIE email, password, and the verification code from SMS or email ready.
- **Fluvius Energy** — {fluvius_status}. [Install Fluvius Energy](https://github.com/sander110419/Fluvius-home-assistant) if needed, then [open Fluvius setup](https://my.home-assistant.io/redirect/config_flow_start/?domain=fluvius). Have your Mijn Fluvius email, password, meter EAN, and meter serial number ready. Choose kWh for gas estimates.
- **Imported kWh statistics** — {statistic_count} found.

If a provider is already configured, check its entry under **Settings → Devices & services**. Once the initial Fluvius import finishes, return here and continue to run the checks again.

pair.title: Select and test your sources
pair.description: Pair one published Mijn Fluvius statistic with its matching ENGIE contract rate. Choose a day far enough back for Fluvius to publish it.

data_description.label: For example, Electricity import, Solar injection, or Gas use.
data_description.price_entity: Select the matching import, injection, or gas rate in EUR/kWh.

review.title: Review your test result
review.description:
**{label}**

- Fluvius usage on {day}: **{usage} kWh**
- Current ENGIE rate: **{rate} EUR/kWh**
- Estimated amount: **€{estimate}**

The test read the selected sources successfully. Check that the meter and contract rate correspond before saving. After saving, open **Energy & Costs** in the sidebar.

error.invalid_statistic: Select an available Fluvius statistic in kWh.
error.invalid_price: Select an ENGIE rate sensor with the EUR/kWh unit.
error.invalid_days: Enter a whole number from 1 to 14.
error.providers_not_ready: Complete setup or repair of both energy integrations, then continue again.
error.no_statistics: The first Fluvius import has not produced any historical kWh statistics yet. Wait for it to finish, then continue again.
error.recorder_unavailable: The Recorder check failed. Check Recorder in Home Assistant and try again.
error.no_readings_for_day: No usable readings are published for this day. Try a day further back or check the meter in Mijn Fluvius.
error.price_unavailable: This ENGIE rate is unavailable or has the wrong unit. Choose an active EUR/kWh rate or repair the ENGIE account.

abort.already_configured: An estimate already uses this Fluvius statistic.
